strategy.name: JAURX Supply/Demand + FVG
sources: Supply/demand zone identification on 4H and Daily
Macro alignment: Fed stance, DXY, yields, VIX
Session timing: NY open + London overlap

indicators.supply_demand_zones: 4H/Daily zones where price reversed with momentum. Valid if: (1) strong departure, (2) not yet retested, (3) imbalance visible.
indicators.fvg: Fair Value Gap on 1H — 3-candle pattern where candle 1 high < candle 3 low (bullish) or candle 1 low > candle 3 high (bearish). Entry on retest of gap.
indicators.vix: Below 20 = normal risk-on. Above 25 = caution. Above 30 = defensive only.
indicators.dxy: Dollar strength inversely correlated with gold. Rising DXY = bearish MGC bias.
indicators.us10y: Rising yields = bearish gold (opportunity cost). Watch ^TNX.
indicators.rsi_14: Divergence confirmation only. Not used as standalone signal.
indicators.volume: Zone validation — departure from zone should show volume spike.

bullish: Price approaching or sitting in a valid demand zone (4H/Daily)
FVG present above current price on 1H (unfilled)
NY session or London overlap timing
bearish: Price approaching or sitting in a valid supply zone (4H/Daily)
FVG present below current price on 1H (unfilled)
NY session or London overlap timing
neutral: Price in mid-range — not near any valid S/D zone
VIX above 30 (too volatile for directional bias)
Outside active session hours (12:00-14:00 ET lunch chop)
Major news event within 30 minutes (FOMC, NFP, CPI)

long: Price retests a valid demand zone on 4H/Daily
1H FVG confirms bullish structure (unfilled gap above)
15m candle shows rejection wick or bullish engulfing at zone
Enter limit order at zone boundary or market on confirmation candle close
short: Price retests a valid supply zone on 4H/Daily
1H FVG confirms bearish structure (unfilled gap below)
15m candle shows rejection wick or bearish engulfing at zone
Enter limit order at zone boundary or market on confirmation candle close

exit_rules: TP1 (50%): First significant S/D level or round number
Move SL to breakeven after TP1 hit
TP3 (20%): Extended target or measured move
Hard SL: Above/below the zone + ATR buffer
Time stop: Close if trade hasn't moved in 4 hours (chop)
risk_rules: 1% of account equity per trade maximum
Maximum 3% daily drawdown — stop trading for the day
No trading during major news (FOMC, NFP, CPI) — wait 15 min after
No trading outside active session hours
If 2 consecutive losses, reduce to 0.5% risk for next trade
kill_switches: 3% daily drawdown hit — done for the day
3 consecutive losses — done for the day
Major geopolitical event breaking — cash only until dust settles
Fed surprise announcement — flatten and wait
Weekend gap risk — no positions held over weekend (futures)
